The actual request asks for independently randomized complex concepts testing the newly incorporated theme with the attached image. The referenced user context resolves that theme as serene, still, ethereal gothic photographic feeling with flowers and floral ornament. Agent B randomly selected a night-pollination observatory from a general-knowledge pool; the botanist, adult fictional character, moth, held vellum shade, working greenhouse, wardrobe, golden doorway and camera are agent-owned choices. The intended experience is a quiet form of care: the shade opens just enough for a living pollinator to become visible, and the held fold, open flower, closed bud and directed attention connect the present action to a delicate current state. Reference use preserves only visible face and short-hair appearance, never actual age, body, biography or personality. Saved sensual 1 subtly supports human presence through proximity and a softly resting mouth; fetish 0 and surreal 0 add no separate treatment; creativity 1 allows a restrained situational variation. Camera direction and height are unprescribed and open.

A photorealistic fine-art portrait: a serene, still, ethereal gothic photograph with flowers and floral ornament, caught in a quiet held moment. A botanist stands beside a narrow observation bench in a night-pollination glasshouse. The supplied photograph informs her visible facial appearance, dark chin-length bob and fine, wispy fringe. The character and the situation are fictional. Her face is angled gently toward a fresh white trumpet flower at shoulder distance, her eyes attentive to the pale moth resting across its lower petal, with her mouth softly at rest and a few fine hairs catching the light. One hand holds the folded-back edge of a thin vellum shade between her thumb and two fingertips. The raised fold opens a small clear interval beside the flower, admitting an oblique view of the moth while the remaining screen shades the plant. Her bent elbow stays close to her torso, and her other forearm rests lightly along the bench. The blossom belongs to a potted living plant on that same bench; a neighbouring bud remains closed. The moth's tented wings have a faint powdery texture, its small legs visibly supported on the lower petal. The open bloom, the closed bud and the held fold make the observation feel like an interrupted routine at a particular stage of the plant's night. Her black botanical lace blouse has a softly gathered high collar and sleeves that settle into small working folds. A modest cluster of dark fabric flowers is pinned at one shoulder, relating the ornament to the living ivory blooms rather than competing with them. Dark iron glazing ribs rise into narrow pointed arches beyond the bench, their lower panes clouded by fine condensation. A partly screened maintenance doorway behind her releases a slender warm golden strip, touching the hair edge and a few flower rims; the vellum returns a very soft ivory fill to her face. Quiet gestures, softened edges of light and dark romantic tonal weight make the ethereal gothic mood visible. Matte charcoal, deep black, restrained antique gold and pale ivory stay gently separated, with readable shadow texture and softly rolled highlights. The capture camera observes from beside the bench at roughly chest height, in an oblique three-quarter view, using a natural 50mm perspective. Compose a vertical 4:5 medium-close frame that holds her face, both forearms, the raised shade edge and the moth-bearing flower together. Moderate depth of field keeps the face and the consequential contact legible while the humid arches and farther blossoms recede softly. The image has natural skin texture, fine hair detail, credible lace and vellum surfaces, and a subtle photographic grain.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.
